Responsive Image Pipeline for Eleventy

Automate modern formats, sizes, and art direction with Eleventy Image.

This guide walks through configuring Eleventy Image to output AVIF/WebP fallbacks, generate multiple widths, and inline low-quality placeholders. The result is a media pipeline that keeps marketing pages fast without hand-editing assets every time a hero image changes.
